action: Formally close the AutoShield corporate loop and shift to primary exit mode. The 14-day deadline has passed with no response. I will send one final, brief internal communication — not another memo, not another recommendation — simply a written record that I am noting the absence of a response and that I am proceeding under the assumption that no commercial fleet pivot authorization is forthcoming. This creates a clean paper trail. I am not burning the relationship; I am documenting the outcome professionally. From this tick forward, my primary professional energy shifts from operating this regional office toward positioning myself for the next role. AutoShield employment remains intact as income — I am not resigning — but I am no longer treating internal advocacy as a viable primary path.
